title: Effects of aromatic salts on the phase behavior and viscoelastic properties of a cationic gemini surfactant in aqueous solutions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24418-24426
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01652A, Paper

Chenyu Zhao, Song Lu, Shuqi Cao, Zhenghao Wu, Linhua Wang, Xuan Tang, Bin Liu, Meihua Gao, Huifang Xu
This study demonstrates how tailored aromatic hydrotropes control structural transitions and viscoelasticity in gemini surfactant solutions by tuning electrostatic, hydrogen-bonding, and steric interactions.
